from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")
EOF"},"tool_call_error":false,"result":"Windows PowerShell

python << 'EOF'
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")
EOF

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")
EOF

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()

ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):

    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")

python << 'EOF'
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")
EOF

python << 'EOF'
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框（可选，让表格更美观）
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side

thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 确定保存路径
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")

# 保存文件
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"文件已创建：{file_path}")

# 显示数据概览
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t增长率")
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")
EOF

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, numbers
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
# 第一个月增长率为空，从第二个月开始计算
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")  # 第一月无增长率
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):  # 第2-6月的增长率公式
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    # 公式：=（本月-上月）/上月
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

# 使用 AVERAGE 公式计算月均销售额
avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
import os

# 创建工作簿
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售数据"

# 设置标题行
headers = ["月份", "销售额", "增长率"]
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", name="Arial")

for col, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 填入模拟数据（6个月）
months = ["1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月"]
sales_data = [85000, 92000, 88500, 96000, 102000, 108500]

# 填入月份和销售额数据
for i, (month, sales) in enumerate(zip(months, sales_data), start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=month)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=sales)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'

# 设置增长率公式（环比增长率）
ws.cell(row=2, column=3, value="-")
ws.cell(row=2, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

for i in range(3, 8):
    cell = ws.cell(row=i, column=3)
    cell.value = f'=(B{i}-B{i-1})/B{i-1}'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# 添加月均销售额计算（在第9行）
ws.cell(row=9, column=1, value="月均销售额")
ws.cell(row=9, column=1).font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial")

avg_cell = ws.cell(row=9, column=2)
avg_cell.value = '=AVERAGE(B2:B7)'
avg_cell.number_format = '#,##0'
avg_cell.font = Font(bold=True, name="Arial", color="FF0000")

# 设置列宽
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 14
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

# 设置边框
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 为数据区域添加边框
for row in range(1, 8):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = thin_border

# 添加分析区域边框
for col in range(1, 3):
    ws.cell(row=9, column=col).border = thin_border

# 保存文件
workspace = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs"
file_path = os.path.join(workspace, "sales_data.xlsx")
wb.save(file_path)

print(f"✓ 文件已创建: {file_path}")
print("\n=== 销售数据概览 ===")
print("月份\t销售额\t\t增长率")
print("-" * 35)
for i in range(2, 8):
    month = ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value
    sales = ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value
    print(f"{month}\t{sales:,}")
print("-" * 35)
print(f"月均销售额: 95,333 (由Excel公式自动计算)")

## Overview

This guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see REFERENCE.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read FORMS.md and follow its instructions.

## Quick Start

```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Read a PDF
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# Extract text
text = ""
for page in reader.pages:
    text += page.extract_text()
```

## Python Libraries

### pypdf - Basic Operations

#### Merge PDFs
```python
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

writer = PdfWriter()
for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

with open("merged.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

#### Split PDF
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(page)
    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
        writer.write(output)
```

#### Extract Metadata
```python
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
meta = reader.metadata
print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
print(f"Subject: {meta.subject}")
print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
```

#### Rotate Pages
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

page = reader.pages[0]
page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
writer.add_page(page)

with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction

#### Extract Text with Layout
```python
import pdfplumber

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for page in pdf.pages:
        text = page.extract_text()
        print(text)
```

#### Extract Tables
```python
with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
            for row in table:
                print(row)
```

#### Advanced Table Extraction
```python
import pandas as pd

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    all_tables = []
    for page in pdf.pages:
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for table in tables:
            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
                all_tables.append(df)

# Combine all tables
if all_tables:
    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)
    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
```

### reportlab - Create PDFs

#### Basic PDF Creation
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Add text
c.drawString(100, height - 100, "Hello World!")
c.drawString(100, height - 120, "This is a PDF created with reportlab")

# Add a line
c.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)

# Save
c.save()
```

#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
story = []

# Add content
title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
story.append(title)
story.append(Spacer(1, 12))

body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
story.append(body)
story.append(PageBreak())

# Page 2
story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))

# Build PDF
doc.build(story)
```

#### Subscripts and Superscripts

**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.

Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
```python
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

# Subscripts: use <sub> tag

## Overview

This guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see REFERENCE.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read FORMS.md and follow its instructions.

## Quick Start

```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Read a PDF
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# Extract text
text = ""
for page in reader.pages:
    text += page.extract_text()
```

## Python Libraries

### pypdf - Basic Operations

#### Merge PDFs
```python
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

writer = PdfWriter()
for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

with open("merged.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

#### Split PDF
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(page)
    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
        writer.write(output)
```

#### Extract Metadata
```python
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
meta = reader.metadata
print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
print(f"Subject: {meta.subject}")
print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
```

#### Rotate Pages
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

page = reader.pages[0]
page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
writer.add_page(page)

with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction

#### Extract Text with Layout
```python
import pdfplumber

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for page in pdf.pages:
        text = page.extract_text()
        print(text)
```

#### Extract Tables
```python
with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
            for row in table:
                print(row)
```

#### Advanced Table Extraction
```python
import pandas as pd

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    all_tables = []
    for page in pdf.pages:
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for table in tables:
            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
                all_tables.append(df)

# Combine all tables
if all_tables:
    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)
    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
```

### reportlab - Create PDFs

#### Basic PDF Creation
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Add text
c.drawString(100, height - 100, "Hello World!")
c.drawString(100, height - 120, "This is a PDF created with reportlab")

# Add a line
c.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)

# Save
c.save()
```

#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
story = []

# Add content
title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
story.append(title)
story.append(Spacer(1, 12))

body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
story.append(body)
story.append(PageBreak())

# Page 2
story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))

# Build PDF
doc.build(story)
```

#### Subscripts and Superscripts

**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.

Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
```python
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

# Subscripts: use <sub> tag
chemical = Paragraph("H<sub>2</sub>O", styles['Normal'])

# Superscripts: use <super> tag
squared = Paragraph("x<super>2</super> + y<super>2</super>", styles['Normal'])
```

For canvas-drawn text (not Paragraph objects), manually adjust font the size and position rather than using Unicode subscripts/superscripts.

## Command-Line Tools

### pdftotext (poppler-utils)
```bash
# Extract text
pdftotext input.pdf output.txt

# Extract text preserving layout
pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt

# Extract specific pages
pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
```

### qpdf
```bash
# Merge PDFs
qpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf

# Split pages
qpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf
qpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf

# Rotate pages
qpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees

# Remove password
qpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf
```

### pdftk (if available)
```bash
# Merge
pdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf

# Split
pdftk input.pdf burst

# Rotate
pdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf
```

## Common Tasks

### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs
```python
# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image
import pytesseract
from pdf2image import convert_from_path

# Convert PDF to images
images = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')

# OCR each page
text = ""
for i, image in enumerate(images):
    text += f"Page {i+1}:\n"
    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
    text += "\n\n"

print(text)
```

### Add Watermark
```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Create watermark (or load existing)
watermark = PdfReader("watermark.pdf").pages[0]

# Apply to all pages
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

for page in reader.pages:
    page.merge_page(watermark)
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("watermarked.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### Extract Images
```bash
# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)
pdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix

# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.
```

```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

for page in reader.pages:

# Add password
writer.encrypt("userpassword", "ownerpassword")

with open("encrypted.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)

## Python Libraries

### pypdf - Basic Operations

#### Merge PDFs
```python
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

writer = PdfWriter()
for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    for page in reader.pages:

```

#### Split PDF
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(page)
    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
        writer.write(output)
```

#### Extract Metadata
```python
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")

print(f"Author: {meta.author}")

print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
```

#### Rotate Pages
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")

page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
writer.add_page(page)

with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction

#### Extract Text with Layout
```python
import pdfplumber

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for page in pdf.pages:
        text = page.extract_text()
        print(text)
```

#### Extract Tables
```python
with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
            for row in table:
                print(row)
```

#### Advanced Table Extraction
```python
import pandas as pd

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    all_tables = []
    for page in pdf.pages:
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for table in tables:
            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
                all_tables.append(df)

# Combine all tables
if all_tables:

    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
```

### reportlab - Create PDFs

#### Basic PDF Creation
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter

c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
story = []

# Add content
title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
story.append(title)
story.append(Spacer(1, 12))

body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
story.append(body)
story.append(PageBreak())

# Page 2
story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))

# Build PDF
doc.build(story)
```

#### Subscripts and Superscripts

**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.

Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
```python
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

# Subscripts: use <sub> tag
chemical = Paragraph("H<sub>2</sub>O", styles['Normal'])

# Superscripts: use <super> tag
squared = Paragraph("x<super>2</super> + y<super>2</super>", styles['Normal'])
```

For canvas-drawn text (not Paragraph objects), manually adjust font the size and position rather than using Unicode subscripts/superscripts.

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

# 创建演示文稿
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(10)
prs.slide_height = Inches(5.625)

# 配色方案
colors = {
    'primary': RGBColor(0x1E, 0x27, 0x61),      # navy
    'secondary': RGBColor(0xCA, 0xDC, 0xFC),    # ice blue  
    'accent': RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF),       # white
    'dark': RGBColor(0x0F, 0x17, 0x2A),         # darker navy
    'light': RGBColor(0xF1, 0xF5, 0xF9),        # light gray
    'text': RGBColor(0x1E, 0x29, 0x3B),         # dark text
    'muted': RGBColor(0x64, 0x74, 0x8B)         # muted text
}

# ========== 第1张幻灯片：封面 ==========
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # 空白布局

# 背景
background = slide1.shapes.add_shape(
    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
)
background.fill.solid()
background.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['dark']
background.line.fill.background()

# 左侧装饰条
left_bar = slide1.shapes.add_shape(
    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, Inches(0.15), prs.slide_height
)
left_bar.fill.solid()
left_bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['secondary']
left_bar.line.fill.background()

# 主标题
title_box = slide1.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(2), Inches(8), Inches(1))
title_frame = title_box.text_frame
title_para = title_frame.paragraphs[0]
title_para.text = "企业数字化转型方案"
title_para.font.size = Pt(44)
title_para.font.bold = True
title_para.font.color.rgb = colors['accent']
title_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"

# 副标题
subtitle_box = slide1.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(3.2), Inches(8), Inches(0.5))
subtitle_frame = subtitle_box.text_frame
subtitle_para = subtitle_frame.paragraphs[0]
subtitle_para.text = "Digital Transformation Strategy"
subtitle_para.font.size = Pt(20)
subtitle_para.font.color.rgb = colors['secondary']
subtitle_para.font.name = "Calibri"

# 底部装饰线
bottom_line = slide1.shapes.add_shape(
    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(1), Inches(4.2), Inches(3), Emu(76200)  # 约0.03英寸
)
bottom_line.fill.solid()
bottom_line.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['secondary']
bottom_line.line.fill.background()

# ========== 第2张幻灯片：转型的三个关键维度 ==========
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

# 背景
bg2 = slide2.shapes.add_shape(
    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
)
bg2.fill.solid()
bg2.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['light']
bg2.line.fill.background()

# 标题
title2_box = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.4), Inches(9), Inches(0.8))
title2_frame = title2_box.text_frame
title2_para = title2_frame.paragraphs[0]
title2_para.text = "转型的三个关键维度"
title2_para.font.size = Pt(36)
title2_para.font.bold = True
title2_para.font.color.rgb = colors['primary']
title2_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"

# 三个维度的数据
dimensions = [
    {
        "title": "技术维度",
        "icon": "⚙️",
        "points": ["云平台建设", "数据中台搭建", "AI智能化应用", "数字化基础设施"]
    },
    {
        "title": "流程维度", 
        "icon": "🔄",
        "points": ["业务流程重塑", "精益化管理", "跨部门协同", "敏捷响应机制"]
    },
    {
        "title": "人员维度",
        "icon": "👥", 
        "points": ["数字化人才培养", "组织架构优化", "文化建设与变革", "激励机制创新"]
    }
]

# 绘制三个卡片
for i, dim in enumerate(dimensions):
    card_x = Inches(0.5 + i * 3.2)
    card_y = Inches(1.5)
    card_w = Inches(3)
    card_h = Inches(3.5)
    
    # 卡片背景
    card = slide2.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, card_x, card_y, card_w, card_h
    )
    card.fill.solid()
    card.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['accent']
    card.line.fill.background()
    
    # 顶部色条
    top_bar = slide2.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, card_x, card_y, card_w, Emu(91440)  # 约0.08英寸
    )
    top_bar.fill.solid()
    top_bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['primary']
    top_bar.line.fill.background()
    
    # 图标
    icon_box = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(card_x, card_y + Inches(0.3), card_w, Inches(0.6))
    icon_frame = icon_box.text_frame
    icon_para = icon_frame.paragraphs[0]
    icon_para.text = dim['icon']
    icon_para.font.size = Pt(32)
    icon_para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    
    # 维度标题
    dim_title_box = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(card_x + Inches(0.2), card_y + Inches(1.0), 
                                               card_w - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.5))
    dim_title_frame = dim_title_box.text_frame
    dim_title_para = dim_title_frame.paragraphs[0]
    dim_title_para.text = dim['title']
    dim_title_para.font.size = Pt(22)
    dim_title_para.font.bold = True
    dim_title_para.font.color.rgb = colors['primary']
    dim_title_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"
    dim_title_para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    
    # 要点列表
    points_box = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(card_x + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(1.6),
                                            card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(1.8))
    points_frame = points_box.text_frame
    points_frame.word_wrap = True
    
    for j, point in enumerate(dim['points']):
        if j == 0:
            para = points_frame.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            para = points_frame.add_paragraph()
        para.text = f"• {point}"
        para.font.size = Pt(14)
        para.font.color.rgb = colors['text']
        para.font.name = "微软雅黑"
        para.space_before = Pt(6)

# ========== 第3张幻灯片：预期收益总结 ==========
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

# 背景
bg3 = slide3.shapes.add_shape(
    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
)
bg3.fill.solid()
bg3.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['dark']
bg3.line.fill.background()

# 标题
title3_box = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.4), Inches(9), Inches(0.8))
title3_frame = title3_box.text_frame
title3_para = title3_frame.paragraphs[0]
title3_para.text = "预期收益总结"
title3_para.font.size = Pt(36)
title3_para.font.bold = True
title3_para.font.color.rgb = colors['accent']
title3_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"

# 收益数据
benefits = [
    {"value": "30%+", "label": "运营效率提升", "desc": "通过流程优化和自动化"},
    {"value": "50%", "label": "决策速度提升", "desc": "数据驱动快速决策"},
    {"value": "25%", "label": "成本降低", "desc": "精益管理和资源优化"}
]

# 绘制三个收益卡片
for i, benefit in enumerate(benefits):
    card_x = Inches(0.5 + i * 3.2)
    card_y = Inches(1.5)
    card_w = Inches(3)
    card_h = Inches(2.2)
    
    # 卡片背景
    card = slide3.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, card_x, card_y, card_w, card_h
    )
    card.fill.solid()
    card.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['primary']
    card.line.fill.background()
    
    # 数值
    value_box = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(card_x, card_y + Inches(0.3), card_w, Inches(0.9))
    value_frame = value_box.text_frame
    value_para = value_frame.paragraphs[0]
    value_para.text = benefit['value']
    value_para.font.size = Pt(48)
    value_para.font.bold = True
    value_para.font.color.rgb = colors['secondary']
    value_para.font.name = "Arial"
    value_para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    
    # 标签
    label_box = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(card_x, card_y + Inches(1.2), card_w, Inches(0.4))
    label_frame = label_box.text_frame
    label_para = label_frame.paragraphs[0]
    label_para.text = benefit['label']
    label_para.font.size = Pt(18)
    label_para.font.bold = True
    label_para.font.color.rgb = colors['accent']
    label_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"
    label_para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    
    # 描述
    desc_box = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(card_x + Inches(0.2), card_y + Inches(1.7),
                                          card_w - Inches(0.4), Inches(0.4))
    desc_frame = desc_box.text_frame
    desc_para = desc_frame.paragraphs[0]
    desc_para.text = benefit['desc']
    desc_para.font.size = Pt(12)
    desc_para.font.color.rgb = colors['secondary']
    desc_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"
    desc_para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

# 底部总结
summary_box = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(4.2), Inches(9), Inches(0.5))
summary_frame = summary_box.text_frame
summary_para = summary_frame.paragraphs[0]
summary_para.text = "数字化转型是企业实现高质量发展的必由之路"
summary_para.font.size = Pt(18)
summary_para.font.italic = True
summary_para.font.color.rgb = colors['secondary']
summary_para.font.name = "微软雅黑"
summary_para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

# 装饰线
deco_line = slide3.shapes.add_shape(
    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(3.5), Inches(4.8), Inches(3), Emu(50800)  # 约0.02英寸
)
deco_line.fill.solid()
deco_line.fill.fore_color.rgb = colors['secondary']
deco_line.line.fill.background()

# 保存文件
output_path = r"G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs\digital_transform.pptx"
prs.save(output_path)

print("PPT创建成功！")
print(f"文件路径: {output_path}")
print(f"幻灯片数量: 3")
print("\n内容概要:")
print("  第1页 - 封面: 企业数字化转型方案")
print("  第2页 - 转型的三个关键维度 (技术/流程/人员)")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import zipfile
import os
from datetime import datetime

def create_docx_manually():
    """手动创建docx文件"""
    
    # 文档内容
    title = "春天的美好"
    paragraphs = [
        "春风轻拂,万物苏醒。当第一缕和煦的阳光透过枯枝,嫩绿的新芽便悄然探出头来,像是大自然的微笑,轻柔地唤醒沉睡的世界。田野间,金黄的油菜花随风摇曳,与蓝天白云交相辉映,绘就一幅生机勃勃的画卷。",
        "春天的气息是甜美的,带着泥土的芬芳和花朵的幽香。漫步在幽静的小径上,微风拂面,仿佛能听见花瓣绽放的声音。那清脆的鸟鸣,是春天的交响乐,每一个音符都充满了欢愉与希望。远处的小溪潺潺流淌,映照着碧绿的垂柳,宛如一幅流动的水墨画。",
        "春天不仅仅是季节的轮回,更是心灵的慰藉。它告诉我们,无论经历了多么漫长的寒冬,生命终将迎来温暖的春天。每一朵花开都是一个承诺,每一片新绿都是一个希望的种子。春天,以它独特的方式,教会我们相信美好的力量,拥抱生命的奇迹。",
        "在这充满诗意的季节里,让我们心怀感激,感受大自然的馈赠,怀揣希望,勇敢前行。春天的美好,不仅在于眼前的景致,更在于它给予我们重新开始的勇气与信心。"
    ]
    
    # [Content_Types].xml
    content_types = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">
<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>
<Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>
<Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.mainXml"/>
</Types>'''
    
    # _rels/.rels
    rels = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/>
</Relationships>'''
    
    # 生成正文段落XML
    paragraphs_xml = ""
    for para_text in paragraphs:
        paragraphs_xml += f'''<w:p>
<w:pPr>
<w:jc w:val="both"/>
<w:ind w:firstLine="480"/>
<w:spacing w:before="120" w:after="120" w:line="360"/>
</w:pPr>
<w:r>
<w:rPr>
<w:rFonts w:ascii="Microsoft YaHei" w:hAnsi="Microsoft YaHei" w:eastAsia="Microsoft YaHei"/>
<w:sz w:val="24"/>
<w:szCs w:val="24"/>
</w:rPr>
<w:t>{para_text}</w:t>
</w:r>
</w:p>'''
    
    # word/document.xml
    document = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main">
<w:body>
<w:p>
<w:pPr>
<w:jc w:val="center"/>
<w:spacing w:after="480"/>
</w:pPr>
<w:r>
<w:rPr>
<w:rFonts w:ascii="Microsoft YaHei" w:hAnsi="Microsoft YaHei" w:eastAsia="Microsoft YaHei"/>
<w:b/>
<w:sz w:val="56"/>
<w:szCs w:val="56"/>
<w:color w:val="2E75B6"/>
</w:rPr>
<w:t>{title}</w:t>
</w:r>
</w:p>
{paragraphs_xml}
</w:body>
</w:document>'''
    
    # word/_rels/document.xml.rels
    doc_rels = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
</Relationships>'''
    
    # 创建docx文件
    output_path = r'G:\MOMA\llm-host-claw\tests\userspace\sessions\5f9b6e51-68d6-4857-a1ea-62e4cb9be2da\runs\spring_essay.docx'
    
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as docx:
        docx.writestr('[Content_Types].xml', content_types)
        docx.writestr('_rels/.rels', rels)
        docx.writestr('word/document.xml', document)
        docx.writestr('word/_rels/document.xml.rels', doc_rels)
    
    print(f'成功创建Word文档: {output_path}')
    
    if os.path.exists(output_path):
        print(f'文件大小: {os.path.getsize(output_path)} 字节')
    else:
        print('错误: 文件创建失败')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        create_docx_manually()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'错误: {e}')
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
